runner.note: The eval registry's not_applicable_until names conformance/pricing/pricing-v1-signature.json, which does not exist, so the dataset in this directory is unsigned and its provenance is asserted by a manifest rather than proved by a signature.

cases.title: Accept the test-only pricing dataset and match its recorded digest
cases.note: The rates are deliberately synthetic — one microunit in, two out — so no run of this suite can be mistaken for a real cost figure. Estimated Cash Burn is always labelled estimated and server interpreted.

negative_case_gap.reason: The dataset is unsigned, so the two refusals that matter — a digest that does not match the data it names, and an entry outside its effective date — have nothing to be checked against. conformance/pricing/pricing-v1-signature.json is the file the pricing-provenance eval waits on.

note: The suite has no negative case and no signature, and both absences are the reason the pricing-provenance eval is not_applicable rather than failing.
